name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis, including an in-driver taste-funnel explore state and design-ratification state) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.58.0 — host generators stop planting narration (specs/20260902/04-host-generators-owner-citations.md): init-gen's rendered rules-file Gotchas header, `/spec:review`'s CLOSE fold, and `/spec:escape`'s Gotchas draft all emit tag + rule + one owner citation (spec path, AC-ID, D-number, ADR, run id) and never dates, people, hosts, versions, or prior behavior; the grounding contract states that duty in § Session grounding and is re-hashed (this repo's own `.claude/spec.config.json` re-stamped), and its own two narrated lines are reworded in the same edit. The plugin-wide narration baseline file is deleted — the standing scan runs at zero with no baseline. Hosts: run `/spec:doctor` to approve the contract re-stamp, then apply the check 16 line-item patches it reports. 7.57.3 — plugin prose sweep (specs/20260902/03-plugin-prose-sweep.md): every narrated line under `spec/commands`, `spec/doctrine`, `spec/agents`, `spec/templates/spec.md`, `git/commands`, and `.claude/rules` now states the current invariant plus one owner id (spec path, AC-ID, D-number, ADR, or run id) — the standing scan holds the prose group at zero findings outside the grounding contract's own tracked baseline entry. `.claude/rules/spec-pipeline.md`'s 15 Gotchas entries collapse from paragraph-length incident narration to one tagged bullet each (`[host]`/`[plugin]` + rule with its mechanism + one owner citation), and the section's header comment adopts the same owner-citation grammar the host-generated rules layer teaches every adopting host. 7.57.2 — plugin code sweep (specs/20260902/02-plugin-code-sweep.md): every whole-line comment under `spec/scripts`, `spec/bin`, `scripts`, and `tests` now states the current invariant plus one owner id (spec path, AC-ID, D-number, ADR, or run id) — the standing scan holds the code group at zero findings and the tracked `.claude/comment-narration.baseline.json` shrinks to prose-only paths, with `comment-narration.js --code-identical <diff_base>` as the executed oracle proving no executable line moved. `spec-build-driver.js`'s `handleTestsAuthored` now expands a tests-layer File Plan glob row (e.g. `tests/**/*.test.js`) through the shared `lib/glob-match.js` instead of checking it as a literal filename — the same matcher `red-check.js` and `scope-reconcile.js` already use — fixing a defect that blocked every spec whose tests-layer row is a glob pattern from ever leaving TESTS.
